name: Creamy Chicken Stew
description: A hearty and comforting chicken stew with vegetables in a creamy sauce.
recipeIngredient: 3 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a Dutch oven. Sprinkle chicken with salt, pepper, and paprika. Cook and stir until the chicken is browned. Drain.
Add raw vegetables, basil, bay leaf, celery salt, and 5 cups broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Remove bay leaf. Add canned vegetables. Cook and stir for 2 minutes.
In a saucepan, mix flour and butter or margarine until smooth. Gradually whisk in remaining 2 cups broth. Bring to a boil. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.
Pour the sauce into the Dutch oven. Stir and bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes.
Serve hot with rolls or biscuits.

keywords: chicken stew, creamy stew, comfort food

_similar.name: Lemon Chicken With Thyme
_similar.description: A flavorful chicken dish made with lemon juice, thyme, and a light flour coating, served with lemon wedges and parsley.
recipeIngredient: Lemon halves and chopped parsley for garnish (optional)

recipeInstructions.text: In a plastic bag, combine flour, salt, and pepper. Add chicken and shake to coat lightly.
In a large skillet, warm oil over medium heat. Brown chicken about 5 minutes each side. Transfer to a plate.
Coarsely chop the onion. Add margarine to the skillet and stir until softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in reserved flour and combine. Add chicken broth, lemon juice, and thyme. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Return chicken to skillet, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover. Cook until chicken is tender, about 5 minutes.
Serve with lemon wedges and a sprinkling of parsley, if desired.

_similar.name: Ken Noodle Supper
_similar.description: A hearty chicken and noodle supper with a creamy sauce, mixed vegetables, and a blend of herbs.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (10 oz/300 g) frozen mixed vegetables

recipeInstructions.text: Cut chicken into 1 inch cubes. Cook in butter in a large skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add onion, mushrooms, and garlic. Cook until onion is tender.
Stir in flour, salt, pepper, and herbs. Cook until thickens.
Gradually add milk, stirring constantly. Bring to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add mustard and noodles. Return to a boil.
Add frozen vegetables. Stir and cook for 10 minutes before serving.

_similar.keywords: chicken noodle supper, creamy sauce, comfort food

_similar.name: Chicken Supreme
_similar.description: A hearty chicken dish with tomatoes, herbs, and cheese, baked to perfection and served over rice or pasta.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil the chicken breasts in a separate container until pink is gone (about 1/4 of the way cooked).
In a baking or roasting pan, mix together the tomato ingredients (stewed tomatoes, green pepper, onion, basil, oregano, garlic).
Place the partially cooked chicken breasts in the bottom of the pan.
Sprinkle spices over the chicken breasts.
Pour the remaining tomato mixture on top of the chicken breasts.
Cover and bake at 350°F for approximately ½ hour.
Sprinkle grated cheese on top, cover, and bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Serve over rice or pasta.

_similar.keywords: chicken supreme, baked chicken, Italian-style chicken

_similar.name: Thai Chicken
_similar.description: A Thai-inspired chicken dish with spaghetti, vegetables, and a tangy sauce, served hot or chilled.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp Sambal Oelek or hot pepper sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta according to package directions for the minimum time. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again.
Stir pasta in a large bowl to coat with sesame oil.
Finely grate the peel from 1 lime and squeeze juice to measure 1/4 cup. Stir juice, peel, soya sauce, hot pepper sauce, salt, and sugar into pasta.
Slice chicken into bite-size pieces, thinly slice pepper, onion, and celery, and julienne carrots.
Stir-fry chicken in batches and return to the pan with garlic and onions. Stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Stir in water, peppers, celery, and carrots. Continue stirring about 3 minutes, adding a bit more water if necessary.
Add snow peas and stir about 1 minute.
Toss with the pasta, serve right away, or chill overnight and serve cold the next day.

_similar.name: Caribbean Chicken Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring chicken, mango, pineapple, and Minute Rice, all tossed in Italian dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 small can pineapple, diced and drained

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the Minute Rice in chicken broth according to package instructions.
Cook the chicken breast meat in a little oil until fully cooked.
Combine the cooked rice, chicken, and remaining ingredients in a large bowl.
Chill until served. Optional: add other fruits like grapes, mandarins, or plums for variation.

_similar.keywords: Caribbean chicken salad, fruit and rice salad, Italian dressing
